subject.title: iOS/WebChat messages append to transcript but do not trigger/deliver assistant replies

question: Is current main or v2026.7.1-beta.2 live proof sufficient to close the native iOS/WebChat no-reply path, or should this remain the canonical tracker until a real iOS app reproduction/fix is verified?
rationale: The source tree has adjacent fixes, but the issue reports a user-visible native app flow and remains labeled for live reproduction and maintainer review; automation cannot safely infer closure from source-adjacent changes alone.

options.title: Keep canonical pending iOS proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a real iOS app send against current main or beta showing `chat.send`, agent run start, and visible assistant reply before closure.

options.title: Close after live beta proof
options.body: If maintainers already have redacted current-main or beta proof for the exact native app path, close this issue with that release and run evidence.

options.title: Split remaining restart path
options.body: If native iOS now works and only post-restart boot-session ownership remains, close this issue as implemented and keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99346 as the narrower tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical pending iOS proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a real iOS app send against current main or beta showing `chat.send`, agent run start, and visible assistant reply before closure.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and the strongest recent contributor on the iOS chat transport/session routing surface.
